description.text:
Crate Opening New Venue in Wood Wharf this October.

We’ve been keeping this one under wraps for a while… and we’re thrilled to finally share the news - we’re expanding! This October, we’re opening a brand-new Crate in the heart of Wood Wharf — bringing our signature pizzas, craft beers, and laid-back vibe to the area.

Our new home is at 14 Water Street, E14 5GX; just steps from the water’s edge, and a 5-minute walk from Canary Wharf station. It has all the ingredients of a classic Crate hangout - afternoon pints, post-work pizzas, and tasty nights soundtracked by DJs and record labels taking over the decks on Fridays and Saturdays. 

Craft beer and Pizza in Wood Wharf, the CRATE Way
The new space will serve up our iconic pizzas like Sage and Truffle, Spicy Salami, and Middle Eastern Lamb. And we’ll also be adding some Wood Wharf-only exclusives to the menu, so look out for some new ones to try (and maybe the return of some historical favourites).

On the taps, you’ll find our core craft beer range, small-batch one-offs and seasonal pours, plus guest drops from all over the craft beer world. 

Not in a beer mood? We’ve got you covered with refreshing Crate soda cocktails, and, wine on tap from Sustainable Wine Solutions, alongside a line up of other specialties to tickle your fancy.

Built by Us, For You
If you know us, you know we like to get hands on; and the refit of Wood Wharf is no different. The fit-out is being done almost entirely by the Crate crew, from the initial demolition, to building the custom banquettes and light installations. We’re completely re-imagining a space, giving it the same stripped-back, hand-crafted feel you’ll recognise from Hackney Wick, but with its own personality that fits right into the new neighbourhood.

Our sustainability minded approach will of course weave itself through Crate Wood Wharf, with Foresso tabletops made from recycled timber terrazzo, Notpla seaweed boards for our pizzas, and wine on tap from returnable kegs. 

Once we’re open, two huge bi-fold doors will be installed, opening the space onto our enclosed garden; which will have room for up to 80 guests to hang out, drink down, and soak up the views.

Same Crate. New neighbourhood. Fresh vibes.

A New Chapter for CRATE
13 years into the Crate story, we’re excited to venture into this new chapter. It’s been a long time coming, and we can’t wait to open the doors to our friends and community, old and new. 

'We can't wait to bring Crate to a new part of London. We feel so lucky to have built an incredible community in Hackney Wick, then we found a space in Wood Wharf that we fell in love with, and wanted to bring the authentic Crate vibe to. The whole family has chipped in for an ‘all hands on deck’ situation to renovate as much of the space as we can by ourselves, the true Crate way!'. - Jess, Founding Director.

Our new home in Wood Wharf opens October 2025 at 14 Water Street, London E14 5GX.

description.text:
Our popular Open Water Swimming is now open for the summer season. 

And alongside it SUP & ORU Kayaking.

In partnership with Love Open Water and Dragon Boat Events, residents, visitors and workers are invited to take a dip and explore by SUP and kayak in the beautiful clear waters of Eden Dock. Enjoy the views of the iconic One Canada Square and Newfoundland whilst swimming in our urban oasis. 

In October 2024, Eden Dock was launched, a reimagining of the historic Middle Dock revealing a waterfront oasis with interconnected pontoons and aquatic islands. 
Open Water Swimming, SUP & ORU kayaking  are the perfect opportunity to get a unique view of this lush planting and floating gardens.

How to Book a Swim

There will be early morning, lunchtime and evening slots available throughout the week. Please download the ACTiO app to view and book swim slots, these will be available to book from early June.

Swimmers will need to purchase a NOWCA membership  – granting them access to all 40+ NOWCA UK locations including Eden Dock.

Each individual swim session is then charged per swim at £9.50, or you can take part in the free NOWCA Swim event that will be offered to members regularly.

How to book a SUP or ORU

Pre-booking is essential via the Eventbrite platform which can be accessed online at https://www.eventbrite.com/o/dragon-boat-events 

Once you have selected a date and 1hr slot, you will be given the option to choose between either a Stand-Up Paddleboard (SUP) or an Oru Kayak.

Your session includes a demonstration and safety briefing before you launch onto the water for your Eden Dock exploration.

Water Testing

Both Canary Wharf Group and Love Open Water conduct regular testing in Eden Dock to ensure it is safe for bathing. 

Venue

Access to the water is from the pontoon next to Humble Grape on Mackenzie Walk, this is also where swimmers will find a changing room, toilets and shower to get ready for their swim. 

For venue and swim session updates, news and announcements, download the NOWCA Wild app and follow the venue swim group – LOW CANARY WHARF.

If you have any further questions please contact the team at Love Open Water  or Dragon Boat Events.

Jamaican Patties are an incredibly popular savoury treat eaten across the whole of Jamaica and now widely available in other Caribbean islands,Canada and the USA.
The product and name are almost certainly derived from Cornish Pasties introduced to the island by Cornish sailors and settlers. Cornwall is one of the 3 counties that make up Jamaica to this day and contains many familiar place names such as Falmouth and Trelawny.
Traditional Jamaican Patties have a crispy pastry and crust usually made with Tumeric which gives the pastry it’s distinctive colour.
Beef,Chicken and Vegetables are probably the original fillings but over time patties in Jamaica have incorporated many other flavours including seafood and cheese. The filling is seasoned with, amongst other ingredients, mixed spices, Scallions, Thyme and Scotch Bonnet Peppers to give a unique flavour.
Patties are eaten in Jamaica at any time of day or night and can be a main meal or just a snack.
JPC’s patties are made to a traditional recipe and baked in store to ensure an authentic experience.
As well as traditional flavours JPC has created Curried Goat,Jerk Chicken and Ackee & Saltfish patties so that UK consumers can experience the flavours of other Jamaican foods in patty form.
